Walter builds your website, or takes over the one you already have, and then treats it as a job that's never finished. He runs A/B tests on your headlines, photos, buttons and offers with your real visitors, keeps the versions that bring you more calls and customers, and retires the ones that don't. Week after week, your site gets measurably better. How is Walter different from Wix, Squarespace or other AI website builders? Every website builder builds your site and stops. Walter treats launch day as his first day on the job: he keeps testing your site on real visitors and improving it every week. No template, no agency and no other AI builder does that. Can Walter take over my existing website? Yes. Point him at your current site and he rebuilds it, keeping your content, your domain and what already works, then starts testing and improving from there. What exactly is an A/B test? Half your visitors see one version of your page, the other half see a slightly different one: a new headline, a different photo, a bigger “Call us” button. Whichever version gets more people to call or book wins, and becomes the new website. No guessing: your real visitors decide. Will my website change without me knowing? You decide. Let Walter run experiments fully on his own, or ask him to show you every change before it goes live. Either way, every test and every result is on the record. You can see exactly what he changed and why. Do I need a lot of visitors for this to work? No. Walter adapts to your traffic: with fewer visitors he runs fewer, bolder tests and lets each one run longer until the result is clear. You don't need to be famous, you just need a website with a job to do. What about my domain and my Google ranking? Your website stays on your domain, and Walter plays nice with Google: clean pages, fast loading, proper SEO on every version he ships. A site that keeps improving is exactly what search engines want to see.
